title: XC707075 - European Herring Gull - Larus argentatus
author: Sonothèque ADVL
changes: European herring gull (Larus argentatus) giving its loud, laughing 'kyow-kyow' call in flight on the Normandy coast near Mont-Saint-Michel, France (Xeno-canto XC707075). Trimmed to 5.30–8.00 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. The default 70 Hz high-pass is kept because the recording has surf and wind rumble below 80 Hz (about −19 dB relative to the calls).
